query: Intel stock price performance and analyst price targets
normalized: analyst intel performance price stock targets

output.content:
**Intel (NASDAQ: INTC) stock performance:** INTC closed at **$89.85 on October 16, 2026** (with after-hours trading at **$89.32**), following a **5.8%** decline in that session; its 52-week trading range was **$32.89–$142.35**. [[1]] [[2]]

- **Year-to-date 2026:** the stock rose from **$36.90 on December 31, 2025** to **$89.85 on October 16, 2026**, a **143.5% price gain**. [[1]]
- **Trailing 12 months:** INTC increased from **$37.01 on October 17, 2025** to **$89.85 on October 16, 2026**, or **142.8%**; it reached an intraperiod high of **$140.94 on June 22, 2026** and a low of **$33.62 on November 20, 2025**. [[3]]
- That puts the October 16 close about **36% below** its June 22 high, underscoring substantial volatility despite the outsized YTD gain. [[3]]

**Analyst price targets:** The broad S&P Global-based consensus tracked by StockAnalysis is **Buy** among **49 analysts**, with a **$118.05** average 12-month target, **$115 median**, **$80 low**, and **$200 high**. [[4]]

- Against the **$89.85** October 16 close, the **$118.05** average implies **31.4% upside**, while the $80 low target implies roughly **11.0% downside** and the $200 high target implies **122.6% upside**. [[4]]
- A narrower, more-recent 30-analyst TipRanks sample produces a more cautious **Hold** consensus and a **$114.04** average target, ranging from **$80 to $155**; its average implies about **30.4% upside** from the referenced market price. [[5]]
- Recent examples illustrate the dispersion: KeyBanc’s John Vinh maintained a **Buy/$155** target on October 15, while Susquehanna reiterated **Hold** and lifted its target from **$80 to $115** on October 12; Mizuho maintained **Hold** while raising its target from **$92 to $114** in early October. [[4]]

**Bottom line:** Intel’s share price has more than doubled in 2026 but remains well below its June peak, while published analyst target aggregates still indicate approximately **27%–31% average upside**; the disagreement between Buy and Hold consensus labels, plus the broad **$80–$200** target range, signals unusually high uncertainty around the outlook. [[1]] [[4]] [[5]]
